dgm.text: The Orzhov Syndicate appears through an Orzhov cleric who tells a visiting scribe that his order is a gateway for life, and leads him to the sanctum to see the Deathpact, namesake of his order.
After the cleric scatters coins around himself, the Deathpact's smoke enters his nostrils and his body withers as a winged, scythe-bearing angel forms from the smoke, coins and gold.
The angel orders the scribe to write down a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat for Teysa Karlov, who must complete the maze at all costs.

clu.text: The Orzhov Syndicate grows wealthier than ever from exorbitant interest on wartime loans, which only makes it hungrier for more.
